name: Circe
source:
A demon summoned by John during a magic ritual. She boasts having great power and pretty much any wish you can think of may be granted by her- for a price. She's granted enough wishes over her long life that she gets amusement in twisting the thoughtless or altruistic wishes of new and unprepared summoners.

[In game description]
